what: A row of cards overlapping horizontally. Each card stands crooked at its own tilt (original −3.9·1.9·−.2·2.6·−3.5°). When the cursor comes to one card, it stands upright and scales 1.025x, cards behind it shift right by (33500 ÷ row width) ÷ distance % (the last card gets .25 of that), cards in front shift left by 5 ÷ distance %, and tilt further by ±2.5 ÷ distance °. The original uses zero bounce and a .3s spring, and moving the cursor continues from the current position. When the cursor leaves the row, cards return to their own tilt

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Cards to stack (several) — each card’s own tilt (deg) in data-tilt
options.push: Share (%) that the back card gets pushed, default 33500 ÷ min(row width, ref)
options.ref: Cap (px) when push is measured in line width, default 986
options.back · turn: Share (%) the front card recedes · extra tilt angle (deg), default 5 · 2.5
options.last: Multiple of the share the last card is pushed, default .25
options.dur · ease: Duration · curve, default .3 · ”0.33,1,0.68,1” (curve close to a zero-bounce spring)
